title_zh: 为诗歌朗读选择简洁灯光和无伴乐开场

scenario.label_zh: 为诗歌朗读选择简洁舞台安排
scenario.goal_zh: 比较复杂布景与诗歌表达的需要，并决定保留单束暖光、取消开场伴乐

context_zh: 诗人和舞台设计者为一首回忆家庭生活的诗安排朗读环境。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: This backdrop is elaborate. Will all those moving images distract from the poem?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: They were meant to evoke the kitchen in your childhood home, but perhaps they tell the audience too much.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: The essence of the poem is the silence after everyone has left. I need room for that.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Would one warm light on the empty chair elevate the reading more than the projections?

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Yes. The chair and light would be enough. Could we lose the music at the start too?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Certainly. We will use the warm light, leave the backdrop plain, and begin without music.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: That feels right. Let us rehearse with that arrangement.
